title: Kicked Spicy Uruguayan Cheese Bake
description: A spicy, cheesy Uruguayan dish featuring pico de gallo sauce, perfect for meal prep, this bake is nut-free-friendly and offers an amazing cheese pull, it is a great option for dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sliced uruguayan sausage to the skillet and cook until browned.
Stir in the pico de gallo sauce, chimichurri sauce, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground beef and sausage mixture, diced tomatoes, and shredded monterey jack cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with the shredded provolone cheese.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the kicked spicy uruguayan cheese bake hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
